races.paceDynamic: Faeberon is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and will likely get an uncontested lead, setting a manageable tempo over this 1m4f trip. With most runners preferring hold-up tactics (Blackisthenewblack, Boilermaker, Caraway, Manbearpig, Raven's View, Gemical, Due To Shine, My Dad Frank), the pace will be moderate through the middle sections. Sweet Love and Jambearee may press but lack the tactical speed to create genuine pressure early. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners and those with proven finishing kicks from mid-division, while pure hold-up horses may find insufficient pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Faeberon gets a soft lead without early pressure from Sweet Love or Jambearee
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow to set up the back-markers, allowing prominent runners to control the finish with horses like Faeberon and any forward-positioned rivals holding sway. Late closers like Boilermaker and Caraway find insufficient tempo to unleash their kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Sweet Love or Jambearee apply genuine early pressure to Faeberon creating honest fractions
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field properly, setting up the race for horses with proven finishing ability positioned in mid-division. Blackisthenewblack and Boilermaker benefit most from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Decides
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with multiple horses trying to get positions turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses with tactical pace and good recent form have the edge over those returning from breaks. Blackisthenewblack's recent win and Caraway's consistency become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the step up in trip or tactical demands
scenarios.body: Long-absent horses like Manbearpig or improving types like Due To Shine capitalize on a muddled pace scenario. The moderate tempo and competitive handicap mark allows unexposed or returning horses to outrun their odds.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Sweet Love or Jambearee fail to press Faeberon early - this will create an unsustainably slow pace that negates the hold-up horses' chances
Monitor Blackisthenewblack's position turning for home - if caught too far back the race may not develop the strong pace needed for closers
Observe Manbearpig and Gemical for market confidence - both returning from breaks under Rebecca Menzies and any support suggests stable expects improvement
Check Boilermaker's early positioning - needs to be handy enough to capitalize if the pace quickens but not so prominent to negate finishing kick
Watch for any interference or trouble in running given the preponderance of hold-up horses likely to be bunched turning for home

races.paceDynamic: Law Of Average is the sole confirmed front-runner and should get an easy lead in this large field, with Glory Fighter the only other natural pace-setter but more tactical than aggressive. The prominent runners like Right And Exact, Castan, Equity Law and Emerald Harmony will sit behind but none are pace-forcers, allowing Law Of Average to dictate terms. With 18 runners over 5f at Thirsk, the pace will be steady early before quickening, creating a tactical affair where position and finishing kick matter more than raw speed. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with tactical speed who can position well and produce late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Law Of Average gets soft fractions and isn't pressed early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the field to reel in and Law Of Average kicks clear in the final furlong like at Bath last time. Front-runners and prominent racers benefit from the lack of early pressure while hold-up horses get caught too far back in the sprint.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady enough for closers to make ground but honest enough to string out the field
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses with class get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks in the final 1.5f. Call To Action and Al Hussar come with strong runs while Brazilian Belle finds gaps from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Winner
scenarios.trigger: If Right And Exact or Equity Law track the leader perfectly and pounce at the right moment
scenarios.body: The winner comes from just off the pace, getting first run on Law Of Average while the hold-up horses meet traffic problems in the large field. Positioning proves more valuable than a finishing kick in a messy sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Law Of Average goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge simultaneously in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with the entire field still in contention turning for home, leading to a blanket finish where any horse can win. Even unfancied runners like Changeofmind or South Parade could nick it in the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Law Of Average must be monitored for how easily he gets the lead - if pressed early his chance diminishes significantly
Watch the stalls for Tees Aggregates who has starting issues, and Tiriac who has been slowly away recently
Call To Action with blinkers on for second run back could be primed for big effort having finished strong last time
Brazilian Belle returning after 39-day break needs to show early sharpness in this competitive sprint handicap
Glory Fighter at 10 years old making the pace could set this up perfectly if he can sustain his gallop

races.paceDynamic: Pink Azalea is the only confirmed front-runner in this field, meaning she can dictate terms without early pressure from Selection and Ey Up Its Jazz who prefer prominent positions but aren't natural leaders. The pace will likely be steady through the early stages, allowing Pink Azalea to bowl along comfortably while the bulk of the field - including Hale End, Mission Command, Starliner, Harswell Ruby, Rajapour, and Rising Force - settle in behind as hold-up horses. With such a small pace contingent and so many hold-up runners, this race shape strongly favours those who can travel kindly in the early stages and have tactical speed, particularly the prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will hit the large pack of hold-up horses in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Azalea gets an easy lead and isn't pressed for pace
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions and prove hard to peg back despite her poor recent form, with the prominent runners best placed to track her. The hold-up brigade will struggle to make up ground against controlled fractions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Selection or Ey Up Its Jazz sit close to Pink Azalea and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: They get first run on the leader while avoiding the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up horses in a bunched finish. Their tactical positioning proves decisive over the large group trying to come from behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Pink Azalea stops quickly
scenarios.body: The race opens up for a closer with a strong finishing kick who gets a clear run through. Recent winners Hale End, Rising Force or in-form Starliner could capitalise if they avoid trouble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Azalea goes too slowly and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: It becomes a tactical mess with multiple runners challenging simultaneously in a sprint finish. The best handicapped horses on current form could sneak through if they get racing room.

watchPoints.text: Pink Azalea getting a soft lead - if she bowls along unchallenged she could steal this despite poor recent form
Selection's jumping from the gates - needs to be handy early to utilise her prominent style effectively
Traffic problems in the home straight with nine hold-up runners likely to bunch up behind the leaders
Rising Force and Starliner carrying momentum from recent wins but both drawn to overcome pace disadvantage
Jockey bookings PJ McDonald on Ravishing Beauty and Jason Hart back on Pink Azalea suggesting stable confidence

races.paceDynamic: City Of Poets stands out as the most natural early leader, with Empirestateofmind, Zapphire, New Image, Hot Cash and Empire Of Light all showing prominent tendencies but likely to settle just behind. This creates a solid but not frantic early gallop over the mile trip at Thirsk, with the pace likely to be honest rather than cutthroat. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Oolong Poobong, Capital Guarantee, Frankies Dream, Impartiality, Leadenhall, Count Palatine and Mr Professor will be looking to pounce late. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick turning for home, avoiding both the pressure of making the running and the traffic problems that could engulf the back markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains honest but not slow, allowing trackers to position perfectly
scenarios.body: City Of Poets and the prominent brigade get first run on the field while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in time. The honest gallop suits those with tactical speed who can quicken from handy positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes slightly pedestrian or the leaders weaken
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks down the Thirsk straight. Those with proven stamina and closing ability capitalize on a slow-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If City Of Poets gets an uncontested lead and the others fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and kick clear when it matters. Empire Of Light's front-running success adds credibility to this approach working.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop becomes truly stop-start with multiple horses trying different tactics
scenarios.body: The tactical battle becomes a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than ability. Those drawn well or with alert jockeys gain crucial advantages in a messy finish.

races.paceDynamic: Sergeant Wilko and Sunriseontheboyne will ensure an honest pace from the front, with both confirmed leaders unlikely to back down early. The prominent runners Persuasion, Sujet, and Brighton Boy should sit just off the pace, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Mudamer, Andesite, and Woodstock will be relying on a strong gallop to set up their finishing kicks. With 7f at Thirsk providing ample time for the race to develop and the good ground maintaining stamina demands, this setup strongly favours horses that can race prominently and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest but not excessive between the two leaders
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get the perfect trip tracking the leaders before striking in the final 2f, avoiding both the early burn-up and getting caught too far back in a big field. This tactical position proves decisive with runners like Persuasion and Sujet ideally placed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses mid-race with leaders tying up dramatically
scenarios.body: The strong early pace falls apart leaving the race to the closers who get a perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. Horses held up early can pick off the tiring pace-setters in the final furlong with fresher legs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Running Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets a soft lead while the other fades early
scenarios.body: The surviving pace-setter gets an uncontested lead and proves too tough to peg back despite the big field hunting them down. The tactical advantage of controlling the race tempo becomes decisive on good ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Carnage Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too hard and eliminate each other completely
scenarios.body: The early battle becomes suicidal with both front runners tying up badly, creating a scramble finish among mid-division horses who avoided the early fireworks. Complete tactical chaos benefits those with most natural ability regardless of position.

runners_data.note: Front-runner who won over C&D last month with visor fitted, likely to make running again
runners_data.comment: Beat 16 rivals to win a C&D handicap last month; fair third on AW since; likely to go well
runners_data.spotlight: A switch of headgear saw him end a losing run when making most in a big-field handicap over C&D last month; not in the same form when third at Southwell 16 days ago; no surprise to see him bounce back.

runners_data.name: Baby Rover
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose best form came at 6f last summer, could benefit from expected pace
runners_data.comment: Of interest on 2025 best; should be at concert pitch after two runs back
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 6f handicap at Redcar (good to firm) last summer off 1lb lower; placed on softer than good twice after; has not hit the same heights this year but at 5f and 7f; should be at concert pitch now and a bigger run could be forthcoming.

runners_data.name: Angel Of England
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with recent fading tendency and stalls issues last time out
runners_data.comment: On a dangerous mark but struggled in 2026 and the stalls remain an issue for him
runners_data.spotlight: He went desperately close at Newcastle (6f) in December off a 6lb higher mark; well beaten since and unseated his rider having reared as the stalls opened (not for the first time) at Southwell 18 days ago; capable but too risky for comfort.

runners_data.name: Ridgemaster
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendency whose 66-1 Newcastle win looks increasingly like a fluke
runners_data.comment: Shock 7f win on stable debut in December (AW); well held twice since; now has first 6f run
runners_data.spotlight: Caused a 66-1 shock when winning a 7f handicap at Newcastle on his stable debut in December; two heavy defeats (7f and 1m) have followed and he now tackles a sprint trip for the first time, with cheekpieces also given a go.

races.paceDynamic: Stormy Pearl and Eldeyaar will dispute the early lead in this 17-runner handicap, with both having confirmed front-running styles and recent C&D form. Seven horses want prominent positions (Ganesha, Valsharah, Run This Way, Crocus Time, Master Dandy, Sanbona, Angel Of England) creating significant congestion and traffic problems turning for home. The honest early gallop from the two leaders combined with the prominent bottleneck will set up a strong pace that burns off the early speed. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scramble and finish with one sustained run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get tangled up 2f out as expected
scenarios.body: The strong early pace from Stormy Pearl/Eldeyaar combined with the midrace traffic jam will perfectly set up the patient hold-up brigade. Horses like Dream Deal and Andalprofit can time their runs perfectly from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Two Battle Home
scenarios.trigger: If Stormy Pearl and Eldeyaar get an uncontested lead and kick clear
scenarios.body: Without serious early pressure, both leaders could still have enough left in the tank to hold off late challengers in a tactical finish. Stormy Pearl's second place behind Eldeyaar here last month suggests they're well matched.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Profits
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent horse finds racing room when others get stopped
scenarios.body: The pace will be strong enough to inconvenience most prominent runners, but whoever gets first run from that group could capitalize on the leaders' honest gallop. Crocus Time's C&D win and Master Dandy's recent form make them candidates.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow early fearing each other
scenarios.body: A tactical crawl would completely change the complexion, turning it into a 2f sprint where the best turn of foot wins regardless of position. This seems unlikely given both leaders' aggressive styles but remains possible.

watchPoints.text: Stormy Pearl and Eldeyaar must both jump cleanly as any early interference between the two pace-setters could completely change the race dynamic
The prominent group of seven horses will create a cavalry charge effect entering the home turn - watch for traffic problems stopping Ganesha, Valsharah, and Master Dandy
Dream Deal returning from 190 days off for Tim Easterby could be primed for a big run but needs to prove his fitness first time back
Angel Of England reared and unseated rider at the start last time - any similar antics here would remove a key prominent runner
Crocus Time has been off for 227 days but has an excellent Thirsk record and could be the forgotten horse in this competitive field
